title: RFdiffusion3 designs ubiquitin ligases for site-specific ubiquitylation
summary: RFdiffusion3 was used to design ubiquitin ligases from scratch with a cysteine-based catalytic triad. Of 48 designs, 35 ubiquitylated a model peptide, and screening 48 designs for PCNA yielded a ligase selective for K164 among 45 lysines. With one activity-increasing substitution and E1-dependent donor activation it reached 90% conversion and transferred di- to tetraubiquitin chains. The work is in vitro and was reviewed from the abstract only.

evidence.tested: In vitro biochemical ubiquitylation assays of designed proteins.
evidence.unknown: Behavior in cells and generality to other substrates; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: RFdiffusion3 generated the ligase designs that were tested.
